title: OpenBindings Interface Document (v0.2.0)
description: Derived JSON Schema for the OpenBindings interface document. It expresses the structural portion of the specification, and OBI-D-02 applies it as published. A conflict with the prose is an erratum; this schema decides OBI-D-02 until a patch release corrects it (see openbindings.md OBI-D-02).

openbindings.description: OpenBindings specification version the document declares. Semantic Versioning 2.0.0 syntax (e.g., 0.2.0). Pattern validates syntax only: whether a processor supports the declared version is explicit implementation support per OBI-T-04 and §8.1, and is not expressible in this schema.

name.description: Human-friendly interface name. Not an identifier.

version.description: Interface-version label: non-empty, author-controlled, opaque to the specification. No ordering, compatibility, or identity semantics.

schemas.description: Named JSON Schemas, reusable through same-document references.

operations.description: Protocol-independent operation contracts, keyed by operation name. Presence alone does not assert that a realization is available.

dependencies.description: Named consumption points, each referencing an operation contract and optionally constraining acceptable kinds.

sources.description: Map of sources: each carries a kind and may carry content read under that kind. The core assigns no meaning to the content.

bindings.description: Binding entries keyed by binding name, each an author-declared realization connecting an operation to a source.

JSONSchema.description: JSON Schema 2020-12 schema: object or boolean form. Where $schema appears on the object form, its value is checked here (OBI-D-06), not its placement: in an OBI, JSON Schema permits $schema only at a resource root, a schema that declares $id (openbindings.md §5.2). OBI-D-06 at nested positions and meta-schema validity (OBI-D-10) are prose rules beyond this schema.

description.description: Human-readable description of the operation's capability, which its bindings claim to carry out (§5.3).

deprecated.description: Whether the operation is deprecated (migration hint).

tags.description: Organizational labels for grouping and filtering.

aliases.description: Additional names for this operation, equal in standing to its key. The key plus aliases form one flat, document-unique namespace; every name resolves to this operation. Carrying a shared contract's operation name here claims correspondence with that operation.

input.description: Contract on each caller-facing input value. Omit to leave unspecified; literal null is not valid at this position.

output.description: Contract on each caller-facing output value. Omit to leave unspecified; literal null is not valid at this position.

OperationExample.description: An operation example: each of its input and output members is one caller-facing value. Positive contract claims: the author asserts that provided values validate against the corresponding specified schemas (§5.1); the claim's truth is not a document rule. Member presence is distinct from value: an explicitly null member is a provided JSON null value.

operation.description: Operation key referenced by this named consumption point. Aliases are not valid here.

kinds.description: Optional unordered any-of constraint over exact, opaque kinds acceptable at this consumption point. Omission declares no kind constraint.

kind.description: The source's kind: exact, opaque, non-empty string used to select an interpretation of the source and its bindings (e.g., example.openapi@1). Never implicitly dereferenced; no version algebra.

content.description: Optional source content, as any JSON value, read under the source's kind. The core assigns no meaning to its presence, absence, type, or members. Member presence is distinct from value: content carrying JSON null is a present member.

operation.description: Operation key referenced by this binding. Aliases are not valid here.

content.description: Optional binding content, as any JSON value, read under its source's kind. It might identify a target or describe value adaptation; the core assigns no meaning to its presence, absence, type, or members. Member presence is distinct from value: content carrying JSON null is a present member.

idempotent.description: Author claim about repeating the operation through this binding: true asserts repetition with the same input, in context differing at most in ways the effects do not depend on, adds no intended operation-level effects after the first; false asserts some valid repetition through it can; absent claims nothing. Not a retry-safety or cacheability authorization (§5.3).

preference.description: Author preference signal among bindings of the same operation: higher is more preferred; equal values express no ordering; omission states no preference and is not equivalent to any numeric value. The specification defines no selection algorithm.

deprecated.description: Author recommends migration away from this binding. Deprecation does not remove the binding or change what it declares; no ordering relationship with preference is mandated.
